summary: Interpolates between consecutive geometry inputs for 3D metamorphosis, blending selected point and vertex attribute classes.
common_gotchas: Compatible topology and attribute layout are needed for meaningful interpolation.
Blend values cross input pairs sequentially rather than only between the first two inputs.
Attribute toggles are independent; disabled classes will not interpolate even when geometry positions blend.
key_concepts: Sequence Blend SOP performs 3D metamorphosis between consecutive geometry inputs.
Blend ranges are sequential: 0-1 blends input 1 to 2, 1-2 blends input 2 to 3, and so on.
It can independently blend position, color, normals, texture coordinates, and up vectors.
Blend SOP and Switch SOP are related alternatives for simpler two-source or discrete changes.
